name: Apple-Beet Slaw with Dill, Raisins, Almonds & Pan Fried Sausage

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium beet
1 Gala apple
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ shallot
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate beet. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apple. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add toasted almonds, broccoli slaw, and raisins to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw
⅛ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: Slice the sausages into bite-sized rounds.
To serve, divide the sausage and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
